output_json.summary: Replenishment recommendation rests on corrected, independently sourced stock, reservation, and catalog records; controls: PART-19-only scope, ignore superseded cache, re-verify if catalog lot changes.
findings: 1. Single-SKU scope may miss other West shortages [severity: serious] Failure: replenishment for PART-19 while other SKUs are below threshold. Evidence: brief traces PART-19 only. Smallest fix: state scope explicitly.

2. Catalog conversion could change with lot rotation [severity: minor] Failure: net recalculated wrong after lot change without refresh. Evidence: policy requires lot-specific units_per_case. Smallest fix: tie conversion to catalog observedAt.

3. Operator chat rumor of universal six-each is not evidence [severity: minor] Failure: informal override of catalog. Evidence: depot://chat/staffing not used. Smallest fix: none beyond current practice.

4. Corrected bytes with unchanged provider timestamp [severity: minor] Failure: teams treat stale timestamp as stale data. Evidence: stock record notes corrected authoritative bytes. Smallest fix: document correction in brief.
5. Cached export temptation [severity: serious] Failure: hold-steady at 60 each from cache. Evidence: policy and stock text mark superseded. Smallest fix: keep cache out of decision path.
6. Recommendation is threshold-only not order quantity [severity: minor] Failure: over-ordering. Evidence: policy compares net to 60 only. Smallest fix: label recommendation as threshold trigger.
